lines: Of threefold will: ya ra lā from awakening,
with the va-letter; śa ṣa sā from the visarga,
with the ha-letter; kṣa, born of the womb-union.
l4.sanskrit_cite: icchāyā eva trividhāyā ya ra lāḥ unmeṣāt vakāraḥ icchāyā eva trividhāyāḥ śa ṣa sāḥ visargāt hakāraḥ yonisaṃyogajaḥ kṣakāraḥ
